screenshotVerification: Links verified against filenames and contracts in source research. 26 charts provisionally reviewed; 418 screenshot date/OCR exceptions remain. A link does not mean individual visual verification.
avrDefinition: Arithmetic mean of last10 completed full NY09:30–16:00 high-low point ranges on same explicit CL delivery contract; fixed before19:30.
timeConvention: Minutes relative to trading date00:00 America/New_York. Negative minutes are previous calendar day. Source bars have five-minute OPEN timestamps. Tag knownMinute includes five minutes for close-confirmed observations.
dataWarning: All2022–2026 data is discovery material. Historical resemblance is not a validated trading edge; original legacy AVR percentage denominator remains unconfirmed.

tagDictionary.definition: Uniform rules across2022–2026; full-day descriptive tags, not inferred trade signals.

Original annotation absent; reconstructed from explicit CL contract5m data. Original nonempty labels remain unchanged. Original and derived legacy fields are not a uniform statistical series; use new all-year tags.
Required source window missing. Never treat as no breakout, no gap, or a losing setup. Twelve Day review dates lack measured-day tags.
Within each named session: H=max high,L=min low,C=last close,R=H−L,cp=(C−L)/R. W=prior NY BBOX width. Compare first-occurrence high and low bars.
R<0.18W; evaluated before all other shapes. This describes compact range, not a guarantee of later expansion.
Session low occurs before high; final close is in top25% of session range. May contain an initial selloff; does not necessarily mean close>open.
Low before high; final close is in bottom30% of session range.
Low before high; close position strictly between30% and75%.
High before low; final close is in bottom25% of session range.
High before low; final close is in top30% of session range.
High before low; close position strictly between25% and70%.
First session high and low appear in same5m bar; no assumed intrabar ordering.

Prior NY09:30–16; NTA uses available bars after prior16 until19:30 anchor, including closed weekend gaps with no invented bars; Asia19:30–02; London03–08:30; NY09:30–16. ATL and LTN remain in whole-day prose.
DST-aware. Interval includes starting bar and excludes ending bar. Bar timestamp is its OPEN; close-confirmed event usable five minutes later.
q=(price−priorL)/(priorH−priorL). Q1:[0,.25),Q2:[.25,.5),Q3:[.5,.75),Q4:[.75,1]. Exact top isQ4; outside remains ABOVE/BELOW. Q2LD is midpoint, not an entire quarter.

From prior16 to current09:30: only upper wick exit with a distinct earlier bar visitingQ1, or only lower exit with earlierQ4 visit. U/X,D/X=other single-side exits; BOTH=both edges; I=neither. Same-bar visit/exit not ordered.
Current09:30 open above priorH / below priorL / inside. Size measured to nearest edge, in prior BBOX quarters. Original2022 legacy NA/UG/DG may differ; preserved, not silently relabeled.
First5m bar touching prior edge; event becomes confirmed by bar end. A filled gap may reopen later; first fill remains recorded.
First bar whose running19:30–08:30 high−low reaches75% of mean last10 complete NY ranges, same contract. BEFORE03 includes crossing02:55 bar, known03:00. Other bands likewise use bar-open timestamps.
O=19:30 open; U=max high so far−O; D=O−min low so far; R=U+D. All nonnegative. A range estimate is not a preallocated upside/downside budget.
First outside observation19:30–02, wick based. If already outside at19:30, this is not proof Asia initiated the breakout; ORDER_CHECK flags source ambiguity.
After first Asia outside observation, midpoint touch before08:30, then London outside observation after03. Not necessarily midpoint before03; source Q2 flags show same-bar timing uncertainty.

Unique sessions with new wick exit after a completed close inside resets episode. Same session may contain multiple episodes but appears once. LondonAIB split before06/after06. Same-bar path ambiguity retained in original BBOX episode data.
L05 in event tags means London0.5, not05:00. UP=LondonIB high+.5×IB width; DOWN=IB low−.5×IB width, IB03–04. This is a half-range extension, not statistical standard deviation.
No touch of that extension04–08:30. This final-day label cannot be used at05. Pattern evidence has separate state known05.
Touched extension but final08:30 close is not beyond it. Does not prove it remained inside throughout.
After extension touch, later bar closes back inside; final08:30 close is beyond extension again.
Final08:30 close beyond touched level, without observed later-bar close-back in source state. Does not guarantee continuous holding or future continuation.
Includes frequent and rare completed-day combinations. Counts include shortened measured days; exclude COVERAGE_CHECK for full-day comparisons. Full three-session combinations are sparse.
Copy combination into filter on Day review R; location pattern intoS; event tag intoT. Gap-fill bands also appear directly inT as GAP_FILL_BEFORE1030, GAP_FILL_1030_1200 and GAP_FILL_AFTER1200.

First inside-close→outside-close transition each day. First later inside close defines return; next outside close defines same/opposite. Already-outside start or jumping between outside sides without inside close is not a new confirmed-return episode.
Prices inCL points. Round-trip0/2/4/8 ticks =0/.02/.04/.08 points. Primary4 ticks=$40 per fullCL contract. Actual commissions/slippage not supplied.

2022–24 vs2025–26 and annual breakdowns are stability checks, not untouched holdout. All history already informed research. Wilson and month-block bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not multiple-testing-adjusted significance.

Tags and tests use saved five-minute bars. This update does not claim a fresh manual inspection of every screenshot. Existing26 individual chart reviews and418 unresolved screenshot date/OCR exceptions remain separate.
